Hi team, 
Thank you for escalating the refund issue to Customer Payments team! 

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

While running the worker instance in the Live Kubernetes, we've encountered several issues:

# {color:#36b37e}*(RESOLVED)*{color} Deploy CGI script has hardcoded IP’s that could access the script. The pool of Kubernetes IP’s was not defined and requests to deploy CGI from Kubernetes instance were failing.
+Solution+: Pool of IP’s were added to the deploy CGI. Updated CGI script was rolled out to all machines. Required security groups were changed to allow access from the Kubernetes workers.
# {color:#36b37e}*(RESOLVED)*{color} On pipeline startup, ssh key was passed as a parameter to the pipeline startup params. This key was later used to build bolt-server modules image. As path to the ssh key differs on EC2 and Kubernetes workers, sometimes we encountered an error during the build that ssh key was not found. 
+Solution+: The bug was fixed and now pipeline resolves ssh key from the exact worker when the pipeline is running
# {color:#36b37e}*(RESOLVED)*{color} Get mandatory locks function returns different response on EC2 and Kubernetes workers. Kubernetes response has significantly fewer locks than expected. Although, it seems that quite often locks are correct, sometimes response is missing a lot of required locks.
+Solution+: get mandatory locks executes git diff with glob pattern. Glob pattern was interpreted differently on the Kubernetes host. To fix the issue, we’ve now passing the pattern as a string explicitly. This way it is consistent across different envs.

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

[~accountid:712020:a9ca1df5-fe05-4efc-9bb7-f89fd653ec94] , I have recently analysed cold mails with regard to Bolt Business. Please find the [ticket |https://taxify.atlassian.net/browse/LSS-37452]with my and Privacy team comments. Might be helpful here.

*Important notice: As of 10 November 2024 the whole Telecommunications Act and Article 10 of the PSEM will be repealed. New Electronic Communication Act will be in force*. CC [~accountid:62d7b457807cf6f78ca9d117] 



+*Summary*+

* I agree with the position that hard opt-in is required in Poland for any kind of direct marketing/outbound sales activities.
* As of 10 November 2024 new act that repeals the whole Telecommunications Act and Article 10 of the PSEM will be in force, therefore there will be only one regulation that concerns consents for marketing.
* I believe that DLP’s opinion results from the fact that (as of today) there are 2 acts that relate to consents for direct marketing which create lots of confusion and various understanding of both acts and relationship between them.
* In my opinion, DLP’s position is a minority one, so taking into consideration that Polish authorities are very strict in this area, I would not recommend it (Polish authorities even present a position that contacting the end-user to obtain his/her consent should be considered as a direct marketing activity which generally means that you are not allowed to offer any products of services if you have not obtained prior consent in any other way). On the other hand, Polish courts usually present slightly less strict position and - in this specific case (judgment of the Warsaw-Praga Regional Court of 4 January 2019, IV Ca 1873/16) - even allowed to contact a consumer to obtain his/her consent for direct marketing.
* *Taking into consideration that the Article 398 of the New Act (defined below) is based on the Article 172 of the Telecommunications Act (which is now considered as more “strict” act than the PSEM) which applies to both physical persons and legal entities, I consider contacting other people with Bolt’s offer as risky, unless Bolt receives prior consent for marketing contacts.*

+*New act to be in force as of 10 November 2024*+

On 9 August 2024 the Polish president signed an Electronic Communication Act (the *“New Act*”) that *repeals the whole Telecommunications Act and Article 10 of the PSEM* (the PSEM Act will remain in force in most part). The New Act *enters in force on 10 November 2024* (some provisions enter later but they do not concern the discussed issue). *As a result, there will be one act that governs the issue of consent to direct marketing.*

Article 398 of the New Act is generally very similar to the current Article 172 of the Telecommunications Act:

# _It is prohibited to use:_
# _automatic calling systems,_
# _telecommunications terminal equipment, in particular in the use of interpersonal communication services_

_for the purpose of sending commercial information within the meaning of the provisions of the Act of July 18, 2002 on the provision of services by electronic means (Journal of Laws of 2020, item 344 and of 2024, item 1222), including direct marketing, to a subscriber or end-user, unless he/she has previously given his/her consent._

# *_The consent referred to in paragraph 1 may be given by the subscriber or end-user by providing an electronic address identifying him or her within the meaning of the Act of July 18, 2002 on the provision of electronic services, for the purpose of sending commercial information to the electronic address provided by the subscriber or end-user._*
# _The use of the means referred to in paragraph 1 to send commercial information, including direct marketing, shall not be at the expense of the end user or subscriber._
# _The activity referred to in paragraph 1 shall constitute an act of unfair competition within the meaning of the provisions of the Act on Combating Unfair Competition of April 16, 1993 (Journal of Laws of 2022, item 1233)._

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses.

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

*Background*: COMP and Bolt Technology OU signed an agreement on technical and trade cooperation. COMP is a producer of fiscal equipment and taximeters and, in regard to the implementation of the Regulation of the Minister of Finance of 26th May 2020 on cash registers in the form of software, developed a cash register in the form of a software called Virtual Cash Register. On January 1, 2021 Bolt Poland (Bolt Services PL sp. z o.o.) began operating as a limited risk distributor of Bolt Services for Bolt. Under the intercompany agreement, Bolt Poland enters into agreements with drivers and fleet partners in Poland, under which the drivers agree to render independent transportation services to Users of the Bolt App within Poland. Bolt Services PL sp. z o.o. became a party of the agreement by virtue of annex no. 1.

If the couple was divorced, the ex-wife wouldn’t automatically have the right to access the deceased’s financial information unless she has been formally appointed as the legal representative of the estate or holds legal power to act on behalf of the heirs (e.g., children).
# *Requirement for Legal Documents*: To release any personal or financial data regarding the deceased, the ex-wife would need to present official legal documentation confirming her right to request such information. This could include a court order, power of attorney, or evidence that she has been appointed as the executor or legal representative of the estate. Without such legal authority, it’s recommended not to disclose any data directly to her.
# *Data Protection and Privacy Laws*: Under Paraguayan privacy law, disclosing personal data of the deceased without proper legal grounds is not permitted. If the ex-wife does not have legal standing, providing her with the financial details of the deceased could be a violation of these regulations.”

It seems that the idea of the service provided by Bolt to business customer has evolved. Please see the communication below but to summarize: the idea is not only charge the service fee but charge the customer with the costs of card plus markup. I am very concern that we may end up with the situation, which we have currently in the re-seller model namely lack of common approach what we understand under business service fee and whether we re-charge the service or add the value. Therefore, before the final decision about the business set-up is done, I strongly believe that tax assessment and our preferences shall be shared to avoid tax burdens and risks.

# Card fee as pass through cost: we know that this topic is quite delicate in PT while disbursement vs reimbursement costs are well described by HMRC. In any country, accounting needs to follow pass through concept.
# Re-charge of card fee costs might be problematic especially if local legislation treat it as financial services (VAT exempt). Selling exempt services limits our rights to input VAT deduction (is finance able to calculate pro-rata?). Plus all the burdens which we already have in RH re reconciliation of in and out invoices.
# Buying (VAT exempt) card service to provide our own service. If we do not do recharge but simply acquiring the service to create our own one, shall be less problematic solution. Nevertheless, we would need to have the good service description in our contract to demonstrate that we do not do re-charge with markup. Then on AP side we’d acquire VAT exempt service. Preferable solution: invoice goes via Telema, no self-invoicing, tax code creation (if needed), confirmation if VAT exempt purchases are to be reported in VAT return. AR side: business service fee. Treatment already provided by Tanel.
# In my opinion the best solution would be to invoice business customer only for our business service fee and allow card issuer to issue separate invoice to the mentioned business customer.

I will summarise this case in order to close the ticket:

We clarified whether it would be advisable to propose a price of 0EUR in the tender and what would be the risks of not complying with the deadlines established in the tender.

* *Price:*
** Article 47(1) of the Portuguese Public Procurement Code (“CCP”) states that the base price, which must be defined by the contracting authority in the contract documents, is the maximum amount it is willing to pay for the performance of all the services covered by the contract, including any renewals. 
** Article 71 of the CCP provides for a principle of Abnormally Low Price or Cost. Under the terms of paragraph 1 of that article, contracting authorities may define in the tender documents the situations in which the price or cost of a tender is considered abnormally low. In the absence of a definition in the tender documents, the price or cost of a tender may be considered to be abnormally low, by a duly substantiated decision of the body responsible for the contracting decision, namely because it proves to be insufficient to comply with legal obligations in environmental, social and labour matters or to cover the costs inherent in the performance of the contract. The consequence of classifying the price submitted as abnormally low is the application of Article 71(3), specifically a request by the jury of the procedure for BOLT to justify the price submitted and thus avoid the exclusion of the tender (under the terms of Article 70(2)(e) of the CCP, tenders whose analysis reveals that they have an abnormally low price or cost, whose explanations have not been submitted or have not been accepted under the terms of Article 71, are excluded). Hence it is advisable not to propose  a price of €0.00, and preferable to  propose another value, however small, so that it is not labelled a free supply (cf. Article 113(2) of the CCP). Details in Jira ticket 37776. 
* *Filling a list of errors and omissions (“Erros e omissões”) / raising questions regarding the ability of the public tender documents to adequately protect the public interest* 
** Within the first third of the deadline for submitting tenders, BOLT may present a list of errors and omissions of the tender documents as well as any clarifications needed for the full understanding of such documents. These errors and omissions should regard (a) aspects or data that are not in line with the reality, (b) types or quantities of works or supplies that are strictly needed to fulfill the contract; (c) technical conditions regarding the execution of the contract that are considered unfeasible. 
** In case of tender with high base price, BOLT may opt to make a presentation to the contracting party, within the first third of the deadline for submitting tenders, noting that if it seems, given BOLT’s estimations, to be possible that the revenue arising from the services provided to users is sufficient to provide the contratual services for significantly less than the base price or even significantly less than 50% of the base price. This may contribute to raise a doubt regarding the ability of the tender documents to adequately protect the public interest. This approach could contribute to start an evaluation, on the part of the contracting authority on the business model set out on the public tender documents, and possibly enable contacts with the market key players in order to better understand the conditions that can be offered, adjust the price of the contract and other aspects of the tender documents that need to be corrected, such as clauses relating to contractual penalties.
* *Consequences of failing to meet the deadline set out in the tender documents*
** The direct consequence of non-compliance with the deadlines established in the contract is the application of contractual penalties established in the tender documents and subsequent cancellation of the contract.
** The application of contractual penalties in an amount greater than 20 per cent of the contract price may lead to a debarment from participating in future public pre-contractual procedures.
** In the event of false statements in the tender, in addition to possible criminal liability, there may be administrative offence liability, punishable by a fine of up to €44,000.00 and an ancillary sanction of a ban on participation in public procurement procedures for a maximum period of 2 years).

It was decided to submit a proposal higher than 0 EUR and that in this case there would be low risks of the consequences of failing to meet the deadlines set out in the tender documents to materialise due to the following reasons:

* All e-scooters and e-bikes would be delivered on time as they are already in Lisbon;
* The delay would be only regarding manual bikes, which represent a minor part of the fleet requested by the municipality (around 300 in a universe of around 2000 e-vehicles);
* Bolt would propose the municipality the deployment of e-bikes instead of manual bikes while awaiting to receive the fleet, at no cost to the municipality (use would be free of charge by residents), showing collaboration and proactivity in solving the issue;
* If needed Bolt can also justify the delay with some written documentation from the supplier of the mechanical bikes.

The municipality published that Ridemove, Bird and Lime propose the offer of 0€. Bolt offered €8.405,25 and Ubiwhere offered €653.173,96. 

As a consequence a statement to the municipality was sent regarding the abnormal prices: [^2024.07.18-Requerimento-Bolt.pdf] 

On August 5 the Municipality informed that the tender was cancelled due to the following reasons:

* 3 out of 4 bidders submitted proposals at €0, and the fourth operator presented a proposal where any penalty would be insignificant considering the low value. Considering this, and the fact that they acknowledge the tender was skewed from reality, particularly from the public interest, they are revoking it.
* Additionally, they detected an error in the tender process, where the age of the vehicles was used as a tie-breaking metric, but it was not required that this be the average age. This means that a bidder could apply with a fleet of a certain age but actually deploy an older fleet.

The outside counsel view was that sending a letter to the municipality would not change the outcome of their decision. Dear Redouane Zouaoui

 

*Data Subject Access Request – Response* 

 

Thank you for your data subject request, which was received by us on *06 August 2024.*

 

After conducting a diligent search for records relating to your access request, we have confirmed that we do process the personal data requested. Data protection law entitles individuals to a copy of their personal data within the search scope – that is personal data, which identifies them, or enables them to be identified from it as a living individual person. 

 

As you may be aware, the right of access under data protection law does not provide an individual with an absolute right of full access to any and all documents containing their personal data. For example, that right should not adversely affect the rights of others, including our trade secrets or intellectual property and in particular the copyright protecting the software.Furthermore, we must point out that if after careful analysis we conclude that our rights or rights of others prevail,  we will not be able to provide you with access to certain documentation where an exemption applies.

 

We will share copies of the personal data we hold about *you* to which you are entitled. This includes:

* *Trip history from 04 May 2023 to 15 May 2023*

 

For information on how we process relevant personal data, we refer you to our Privacy Policy at [Terms and Conditions|https://bolt.eu/en/legal/] , which includes further information about:

* The categories of personal data we process;
* The purposes for which we process personal data;
* The recipients or categories of recipients to whom the personal data has been or will be disclosed;
* The criteria we use to determine how long to retain personal data;
* The sources of personal data received from other parties;
* Your rights in relation to your personal data;
* The existence and envisaged consequences of any automated decision-making/profiling of personal data; and
* Details of any transfer of your personal data to third countries or international organisations and the safeguards used for any such transfers.

 

*Your rights* 

 

In addition to your right to access any personal data we hold about you, you have the right to request us to rectify, erase your personal data, restrict the processing of your personal data or to object to such processing. Any such requests that are received will be considered in conjunction with the applicable provisions of relevant data protection laws. 

 

If you are dissatisfied with this response to your request or in relation to any other matter relating to the processing of your personal data, we hope you will continue to work with us to resolve them. You also have the right to complain directly to your data protection/supervisory authority and, depending on the applicable data protection laws in your country, to seek a judicial remedy.

 

If you have any additional questions, please contact our Customer Support Team by replying to this email.

 

 

Yours sincerely,



Bolt

Dear Alex Moulsley

 

*Data Subject Access Request – Response* 

 

Thank you for your data subject request, which was received by us on *07 August 2024*

 

After conducting a diligent search for records relating to your access request, we have confirmed that we do process the personal data requested. Data protection law entitles individuals to a copy of their personal data within the search scope – that is personal data, which identifies them, or enables them to be identified from it as a living individual person. 

 

As you may be aware, the right of access under data protection law does not provide an individual with an absolute right of full access to any and all documents containing their personal data. For example, that right should not adversely affect the rights of others, including our trade secrets or intellectual property and in particular the copyright protecting the software.Furthermore, we must point out that if after careful analysis we conclude that our rights or rights of others prevail,  we will not be able to provide you with access to certain documentation where an exemption applies.

 

We will share copies of the personal data we hold about *you* to which you are entitled. This includes:

* *Specific trip history*

 

For information on how we process relevant personal data, we refer you to our Privacy Policy at [Terms and Conditions|https://bolt.eu/en/legal/] , which includes further information about:

* The categories of personal data we process;
* The purposes for which we process personal data;
* The recipients or categories of recipients to whom the personal data has been or will be disclosed;
* The criteria we use to determine how long to retain personal data;
* The sources of personal data received from other parties;
* Your rights in relation to your personal data;
* The existence and envisaged consequences of any automated decision-making/profiling of personal data; and
* Details of any transfer of your personal data to third countries or international organisations and the safeguards used for any such transfers.

 

*Your rights* 

 

In addition to your right to access any personal data we hold about you, you have the right to request us to rectify, erase your personal data, restrict the processing of your personal data or to object to such processing. Any such requests that are received will be considered in conjunction with the applicable provisions of relevant data protection laws. 

 

If you are dissatisfied with this response to your request or in relation to any other matter relating to the processing of your personal data, we hope you will continue to work with us to resolve them. You also have the right to complain directly to your data protection/supervisory authority and, depending on the applicable data protection laws in your country, to seek a judicial remedy.

 

If you have any additional questions, please contact our Customer Support Team by replying to this email.

 

 

Yours sincerely,



Bolt

Hi [~accountid:62bff85c118b20bee2bdca35] , thanks for this. First, I’d like to clarify a couple of points from privacy POV:

* Next step in any case will be to identify legal basis and we have two options:
** Legal obligation (compliance with a law that gives them the right to request data from us) - no LIA needed - *preferred one*
** Legitimate interest (if there is no such law as mentioned in bullet point above) - LIA needed - *only if there is no legal obligation*
* This means that we will not be conducting a LIA before we receive response from ONSS.



*Next steps:*

* Ask for legal basis - we may use this wording:
** We acknowledge your request *dated XX.*
Firstly, we wanted to assure you that Bolt understands the seriousness of this request and we look to assist authorities whenever we are able to.
At Bolt, we take the privacy and security of our customers, employees, and independent contractors very seriously. We only engage in data sharing with third parties where we are satisfied that the requirements of our third party data sharing policy and those of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR) have been met. This means that the request for data is lawful, necessary, proportionate, and limited to the specific purpose outlined in the request.
After carefully reviewing your request, we have determined that you have not provided us with a reference to the specific law or regulation that obliges Bolt to disclose the data requested. In this instance, Bolt will be unable to meet its legal requirements under EU GDPR for establishing a legal basis for data disclosure.
To allow us to validate your request, *we kindly advise you to provide a reference to the specific law or regulation which allows Bolt to provide you with the requested personal data*. Providing the necessary details will enable us to properly process your request in accordance with applicable privacy laws and regulations.
* If they provide us with a reference to a law and if it’s valid - we can share data based on *_compliance with a legal obligation_* as a legal basis, instead of legitimate interest.
* If they don’t do it, we will rely on legitimate interest and perform a LIA.



Hope that makes sense!

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Yours sincerely,

*Opt-In Requirement in UAE:* Opt-in consent from users in Dubai and across the UAE is mandatory for sending direct marketing communications.

It cannot be obtained via a privacy notice, and must be separately requested (i.e. via a checkbox).

*Strict consent-record keeping rules for SMS:* Bolt is required to create an SMS consent database and share it with local telecommunications providers [+per this procedure+|https://www.etisalat.ae/en/system/wst/assets/docs/business/general/etisalat-consent-management-service-policy.pdf] to prevent SMS from being blocked.

*Scope of channels:*

* Email
* WhatsApp messages and similar services
* Push notifications
* SMS

*Applicability (at least one criteria must apply):*

* Direct marketing is conducted by a company in the UAE.
* Message is sent to devices located in the UAE.
* Received by Individuals Physically in the UAE at the time of receipt.
* Applicable to both B2C and B2B contexts.

*Enforcement Risk - high*.

* *Likelihood - high.* Authorities are strict, actively monitor compliance, and are very likely to take action.
* *Amount of fines* - up to 50 000 USD for general consent infringements per violation;  up to 70 000 USD for SMS rules per violation.

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

After each A/B test we run the extended scorecard script that calculates annual absolute contribution profitability of experiment. Script is deployed as a Databricks workflow, with configurable parameters ({{{"test_id": 123, "city_id": 456, ...}}}). Main results of the script is the scorecard table with calculated metrics.
As of now results are stored in Databricks environment for ~2 month. It is possible to download them and store them in some folder, but with the scale of experimentation it can easily go out of control.
As a User I want to store all scorecard results to some database and been able to expose them through Admin Panel.

Regarding implementation as DS I can store metadata of all script runs and results to the files on S3 bucket in the format we could align. From Pricing Backend side the task would be to fetch them and make them available, filterable and searchable in Admin Panel.

Hi team, 
Thank you for escalating the refund issue to Customer Payments team! 

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

** triggered hpa
** freshly started pods received traffic before startup garbage was collected

Hi team, 
Thank you for escalating the refund issue to Customer Payments team! 

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

*Summary - preliminary view on how to differentiate  between Bolt Business company requests & DSRs:*

# *Corporate Requests (not a DSR):*
#* A corporate request is defined as one made by a business customer that does not pertain to specific individuals.
#* *Handling Corporate Requests:*
#** The DSR process and associated deadlines do not apply to corporate requests. However, these guidelines can be used as a framework in the absence of specific procedures for Corporate Requests.
#** Bolt is not considered a data processor for Business customers, and there are no established procedures under the Business T&C for handling requests such as data deletion. Therefore, Bolt is not obligated to take action on such requests. Nevertheless, Bolt must present a valid lawful basis for continuing to process the data, which could be challenging for certain activities.
#** Bolt must remain responsive and try to action the request, clarifying if this is a DSR where not clear. Not responding will cause friction with the business customers and complaints.
# *Applying the DSR Process:*
#* The DSR process should be applied when:

Dear Julien ruzzene

 

*Data Subject Access Request – Response* 

 

Thank you for your data subject request, which was received by us on *10 August 2024.*

 

After conducting a diligent search for records relating to your access request, we have confirmed that we do process the personal data requested. Data protection law entitles individuals to a copy of their personal data within the search scope – that is personal data, which identifies them, or enables them to be identified from it as a living individual person. 

 

As you may be aware, the right of access under data protection law does not provide an individual with an absolute right of full access to any and all documents containing their personal data. For example, that right should not adversely affect the rights of others, including our trade secrets or intellectual property and in particular the copyright protecting the software.Furthermore, we must point out that if after careful analysis we conclude that our rights or rights of others prevail,  we will not be able to provide you with access to certain documentation where an exemption applies.

 

We will share copies of the personal data we hold about *you* to which you are entitled. This includes:

* *Trip history*

 

For information on how we process relevant personal data, we refer you to our Privacy Policy at [https://bolt.eu/en/legal/|https://bolt.eu/en/legal/] , which includes further information about:

* The categories of personal data we process;
* The purposes for which we process personal data;
* The recipients or categories of recipients to whom the personal data has been or will be disclosed;
* The criteria we use to determine how long to retain personal data;
* The sources of personal data received from other parties;
* Your rights in relation to your personal data;
* The existence and envisaged consequences of any automated decision-making/profiling of personal data; and
* Details of any transfer of your personal data to third countries or international organisations and the safeguards used for any such transfers.

 

*Your rights* 

 

In addition to your right to access any personal data we hold about you, you have the right to request us to rectify, erase your personal data, restrict the processing of your personal data or to object to such processing. Any such requests that are received will be considered in conjunction with the applicable provisions of relevant data protection laws. 

 

If you are dissatisfied with this response to your request or in relation to any other matter relating to the processing of your personal data, we hope you will continue to work with us to resolve them. You also have the right to complain directly to your data protection/supervisory authority and, depending on the applicable data protection laws in your country, to seek a judicial remedy.

 

If you have any additional questions, please contact our Customer Support Team by replying to this email.

 

 

Yours sincerely,



Bolt

h3. Summary of Marqeta Compliance and Bolt’s Next Steps - FYI [~accountid:63622ea17d4645af4f03bd18] to align on the approach.

Privacy has reviewed an important commerce provider that will help issue Bolt`s corporate cards as a data processor.

The provider’s default DPA is generally compliant with GDPR, but there are a few areas that need updates:

*International Data Transfers:*

* *_Current Status:_* _Marqeta's DPA lacks references to a specific data transfer mechanism. The provider clarified that it is EU-US DPF certified, but has not yet updated its DPA to reflect that. They are open to include SCCs._

*Subprocessor Engagement:*

* *_Current Status:_* _Marqeta relies on general authorization with a 20-day notice for subprocessors. While not the default standard, this can be accepted, as the provider is audited and possesses a handful of security certifications, including ISO27001._

*Liability Limitation:*

* *_Current Status:_* _Marqeta's Service Agreement includes a standard liability clause, limiting liability to the maximum extent permitted under Applicable Law. Also, the DPA does not include liability clauses for controllers (Bolt)._

*Notification Procedures:*

* *_Current Status:_* _The DPA does not ensure clear timelines for notification procedures for DSRs and data breaches, pursuant to Bolts internal standards._

h3. Next steps:

*I prepare to push for the adoption of Bolt`s standard DPA with SCCs & UK addendum attached. Marqeta clarified that it is willing to review our template on our call 6.09.* Additionally, they are open to suggestions from Bolt to ensure its privacy compliance procedures meet Bolt’s processor standards.

The email to Marqeta is below. It summarises the discussion points from the call we had earlier today:

{panel:bgColor=#eae6ff}
_Dear [name],_

_Thank you for the productive call and for discussing Bolt’s concerns regarding the default DPA attached by Marqeta._

_We wanted to summarise the key points of our discussion:_

# *_Alignment with Bolt’s Standards:_* _Marqeta is open to Bolt's suggestions to align the DPA with Bolt's internal standards for processors. The standards are designed to clarify collaboration procedures under Article 28 of the GDPR, including notification timelines for responding to data subject requests._
# *_International Data Transfers:_* _Marqeta currently does not include information on the international data transfer mechanism in the DPA. Marqeta is open to adding a reference to EU SCCs and the UK IDTA to cover international data transfers._
# *_Review of Bolt’s Standard DPA Template:_* _Marqeta is willing to review Bolt's standard DPA template._

_Please find attached Bolt’s standard DPA template, which we propose as the basis for our agreement. Using Bolt's standard DPA will help streamline the process and minimise the need for amendments to the standard agreement._

_Thank you again for your cooperation, and I look forward to your feedback._

_Best regards,_

# However, the matter signifies there is a gap in privacy guidelines for the fraud team on the restriction to request & process personal data.

*Main request:* to assess the lawfulness of the current fraud procedures in Poland re/ IDs requests; align with fraud on updated procedures.

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Hi team, 
Thank you for escalating the refund issue to Customer Payments team! 

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Each type is generated by the {{getString}} function in {{DeclarationPrinter}}([https://github.com/bolteu/bolt-nodejs-common/blob/56aee62cb6f3e8a59c72e75a84360b7d445e26f7/src/apiGenerator/util/interfaceResolver/main/DeclarationPrinter.ts#L56|https://github.com/bolteu/bolt-nodejs-common/blob/56aee62cb6f3e8a59c72e75a84360b7d445e26f7/src/apiGenerator/util/interfaceResolver/main/DeclarationPrinter.ts#L56]). If {{this.customTypeManager.shouldExportTypeAliasDeclaration}} returns {{false}} for a specific type ([https://github.com/bolteu/bolt-nodejs-common/blob/56aee62cb6f3e8a59c72e75a84360b7d445e26f7/src/apiGenerator/util/interfaceResolver/main/DeclarationPrinter.ts#L85|https://github.com/bolteu/bolt-nodejs-common/blob/56aee62cb6f3e8a59c72e75a84360b7d445e26f7/src/apiGenerator/util/interfaceResolver/main/DeclarationPrinter.ts#L85]), the type declaration correctly results in an empty string. However, the {{getString}} function still proceeds with generating comments (if they exist), even though the type definition is missing.

*Proposed solution*: Modify the {{getString}} function in {{DeclarationPrinter}} so that if {{shouldExportTypeAliasDeclaration}} returns {{false}}, the function immediately returns an empty string, preventing any further generation (including comments).

A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Hi team, 
Thank you for escalating the refund issue to Customer Payments team! 

Chances are your question has been already answered in the Knowledge Base. 
https://beehive.bolt.eu/customer_support/kb/articles/internal/360016883020

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin. 

Q: I would like to issue a refund, but I don't have the necessary accesses. 
A: Your team lead should have permissions to issue refunds. Please escalate to them. If they are lacking any permissions then you can apply for the following in Admin. 
Rides: refund_payments, customer_support_beehive_ridehailing_order_refund
Delivery: Refund old orders (delivery_order_refund_extended) after 30 days
Rentals: rental_order_refund, rental_subscriptions_refund, rental_order_refund_city_fine
Carsharing: rental_car_order_refund
Bolt+: subscription_offer_customer_support

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Also all the numbers shown there are with VAT.

Happy to hop on a call to explain what the different tabs are meant to do but here’s a quick summary:

* all_invoices_Jan-Nov_2023
** This tab checks the Billing records against the generated PDF invoice for fleets in Jan - Nov 2023
** This tab checks if the generated PDF invoice is correct or not based on the Billing records
** I believe [~accountid:61b10873c75da8007263c3ec] already shared this with you where we figured most of the PDF invoices are correctly generated
* all_invoices_Dec_2023_v3
** This is using the same logic as above ^ but this time for fleets in December 2023
** This tab also checks if generated PDF invoice is correct or not based on the Billing records
** Uses the same logic as Carlos' analysis where we figured the main issue is uninvoiced Demand Incentives for open invoices before Dec 2023 (total ~70M PLN gross is missing from the PDF invoices)

----

* 2023_monthly_data_raw & 2023_summary_raw (pivot table) 
** These tabs show the same data but one is simply a summary per fleet & month 
** The assumption behind this that the PDF invoice generated is incorrect & we shouldn’t try to match records with the invoice
** This simply summarises all the Billing records per invoice row type (fees, bonus, netting, custom_fee aka loyalty_bonus) & checks what should be the monthly invoice total per month per fleet
* 2023_monthly_data_periodically
** This tab is a follow-up of the one ^ but also takes into account the fact we cannot generate the PDF invoice if the monthly total is negative. 
** It calculates the monthly total invoice sum & if the total is negative it’s going to be passed on to the next month (& if next month total is also -ve the totals pass on to the next month & to the next month etc) 
** This tab also takes into account the fact the year 2022 might’ve ended up invoice total = negative hence 2022 numbers pass on to 2023
** This is good to check how much we should (+ could) invoice fleets in 2023
* monthly_with_start_end_dates
** This is the same as one ^ but this time I assign the proper invoicing period start & end dates.
** If the monthly invoice sum is positive (& there’s nothing to invoice for the previous month(s)) the invoicing period is just the month. e.g. from 01 Jan 2023 to 31 Jan 2023
** If the monthly invoice sum is negative (or theres some overlap from previous month(s)) the invoicing period shows the full period e.g. from 01 Sept 2023 to 31 Oct 2023
** This is good to check how the actual PDF invoice should’ve been generated (in case we have multi-month invoices) 
* PL_fleet_2023_invoices
** This is a follow-up to the once ^ but only showing the proper invoice details for invoices we could actually generate in 2023 (period end date is in 2023 & the invoice sum is positive)
** It highlights the correct invoicing period start & end dates + the invoice row sums (with VAT) 
** Also includes the invoice issuer details + VAT % (afaik these are not really relevant as we should fix invoices to the fleets with flat 23% VAT rate) 
** This should be the source of truth of our 2023 PL fleet invoices. These are the PDF invoices we should’ve generated
* comparison_vs_PDF
** This tab simply compares the data from tab above ^ with the PDF invoices generated (join against period end date)
** As we can see some PDF invoices weren’t generated at all for fleets for all periods. One of the reasons for this may be that this fleet was under a Holding Fleet or our system just didn’t pick up the invoice due to frequent invoice issuer changes. This is something I need to investigate further
** But hopefully it gives a better overview between what happened vs what should’ve happened

* If it’s an email, CS checks if email matches the one on the driver’s profile.

FAQ

Q: Can the Payment OPS issue a refund? 
A: No, Payment OPS don't have an access to issue a refund in Beehive or in Admin.

Q: Customer requests a refund to the original payment method. 
A: If you have already issued a refund to the Bolt Balance, but the customer is requesting a refund to OPM. You need to force the refund to Original payment method. We are not able to remove the balance. The customer will receive a double-refund. 

Q: Can I refund after Chargebacks?
A: No. If the customer has received a chargeback then we are not able to issue a refund. 

If this solved your issue then we will close the ticket in 5 days. 
If you would still like the payment operations team to take a look at this issue then please leave a comment on the ticket and we will not close the case.

Just for future references, the 'top_up_success' event no longer exists, as it was removed during the 'multi-brand' project.

*Reason:*

Previously, this event was used by the rider-pushes and delivery-push services to send notifications to users. However, the process has been updated, and push notifications are now handled through balance-user-order. As a result, there is no longer a need for the 'top_up_success' event.

In relation to this ticket, changes were made to send lifecycle 'event' data through a synchronous call to:

*/event/internal/store*

This update shouldn’t cause any issues.

Hi [~accountid:60630d4b8a0f7c006fb3738d], thanks for raising this.

While cross-checks like these are not generally prohibited under privacy laws, we must take certain extra steps to ensure compliance with those laws.

I have a few questions:

# Do we really need to keep all the data points in the sheet? For example, instead of full names and personal codes, would it be sufficient to retain just the Driver ID? I am less concerned about vehicle data, but I'd prefer to limit the amount of personal data we keep to the bare minimum to minimize any risks.
# Authorities can revoke licenses if a driver no longer meets the required conditions (e.g., criminal convictions, right to live/work in the country). Will we have access to the reasons for license revocation? I’m asking because some of these reasons, particularly involving criminal conviction data, are subject to stricter privacy law rules. So, will we receive or store any details on the specific reasons for revocation?
# Since these checks will be conducted regularly, we need to establish clear data retention periods. Otherwise, we'll accumulate unnecessary data over time. From my perspective, the most appropriate approach would be to delete the data after the checks are completed, or at least retain only minimal data such as the Driver ID, date of the check, and whether the driver’s documents were valid. This ties in with the first point about minimizing the amount of personal data.
# In other markets, when we have similar initiatives, we sign Terms and Conditions + Data Sharing Agreements with government database providers. How will it work in this case? Is it possible to sign an agreement with them, or do they offer any terms via their website?

While generally it not forbidden to perform such cross-checks under privacy laws, to comply with the law, we need to take some extra steps.

Let me know your thoughts!

_Bolt will only use your personal data to communicate with you about the Campaign through direct marketing and in-app notifications, in line with our privacy notices.
